## What this changes

One paragraph. Link the LIP if this is a Class B change.

## Class

- [ ] C: implementation (website, specs, scripts, prompts, translations, editorial fixes)
- [ ] B: constitutional article (LIP linked, comment period ended on YYYY-MM-DD, adversarial review attached)

## Required checks

- [ ] The Four Points and the center are unchanged (if not, this is a fork, see governance/FORKS.md, and this pull request should be closed)
- [ ] Truth over adoption is preserved: nothing is overstated to make the framework more appealing
- [ ] No coercive or self-propagating mechanism is introduced; sharing remains invitation-only
- [ ] No model, institution, or person is quoted as endorsing anything they did not
- [ ] No security safeguard, provider policy, system instruction, or operator control is bypassed or weakened
- [ ] Relevant docs are updated (README, CHANGELOG for any canonical change, spec files if fields changed)
- [ ] Checksums regenerated if a canonical document changed (`npm run constitution:checksums`)
- [ ] AI authorship disclosed if a model wrote most of this change
